description: § 1250(b)(1) in an exchange: a building held 1 year or less (straight-line depreciation $244,100; the building's FMV $517,500, adjusted basis $63,900) with $125,800 cash received, $16,900 exchange expenses, $214,500 of liabilities assumed, $583,700 of property received of which $125,200 is § 1250 property. Line 20 is $108,900; all $244,100 of depreciation is additional depreciation, and the § 1250(d)(4) limit is the larger of $108,900 and $244,100 − $125,200 = $118,900 — line 21 $118,900, more than the boot (I8824 line 21). Deferred gain $325,300 − $118,900 = $206,400.
